description: This PHP class defines a validation rule for Base64-encoded file attachments, ensuring they meet specified type, extension, size, and filename length constraints within a human resource management system.

classes.name: Base64Attachment
classes.description: A validation rule class for verifying base64-encoded file attachments based on type, extension, size, and filename length constraints.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing allowed types, extensions, filename length bounds, size constraints, and size strictness.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input array for attachment details, including type, extension, filename length, and size constraints.

methods.name: validateMin
methods.description: Checks if filename length meets the minimum length requirement.

methods.name: validateMax
methods.description: Checks if filename length does not exceed the maximum length requirement.
